name: Survey tile in Libra
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 3.2 degrees north of the ecliptic in Libra, imaged by SPHEREx 10 times in 3 visits over 26 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 18 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 26 hours starting 2026-02-05, at wavelengths from 1.05 to 4.14 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
